* Her quiet humming threads between the trees, rising and falling with her steps, until distant birds pause their own songs and listen. <0.06>
* Pine needles cushion each footfall, sending up a faint sharp scent that mingles with the warm smell of fresh bread and sweet jam from the basket. <0.07>
* Shafts of pale sunlight slip through the high branches and pass over her cloak, so that her hood flashes and dims like a moving ember. <0.09>
